from fixtures import load_fixtures, ROWS
from captions import label_fixtures

NAMES = ["n%d" % i for i in range(len(ROWS))]


def test_lines_present():

    assert len(lines) == len(ROWS)


def test_lookup():
    lookup, lines = label_fixtures(NAMES, load_fixtures())
    assert lookup["n0"] == ROWS[0][1]
